meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
If you want a beautiful saree for a wedding without spending too much, I’d recommend **Banarasi art silk, Kanjivaram-style silk blend, or an embroidered georgette saree**\. These can give you a festive, dressed-up look without the price of genuine silk.

For online shopping in India, a budget of ₹1,000–₹3,000 gives you plenty of options. Current listings on Flipkart and LimeRoad include wedding-style sarees below ₹1,500, while Myntra also has festive styles worth comparing.
